data.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one Fighting Style from the options below. You can't take the same Fighting Style option more than once, even if you get to choose again.
data.note: Choose one Fighting Style. The chosen style is a separate `kind:feature` row; the pick is stored in character.featureChoices['fighting-style-fighter'].feature.feature and the engine loads that row so its modifiers derive normally.

data.description: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.
data.note: +1 AC when wearing armor. The engine does not enforce the armor requirement via appliesWhen (requires-field is not evaluated); +1 applies unconditionally — same as the feat version.

data.description: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.
data.note: +2 damage with melee weapon attacks. SRD: applies only when wielding in one hand with no other weapons — engine cannot check weapon-hold state, applies unconditionally to all melee attacks. Fixed: was a stat-modifier (damage.bonus.melee) that was never evaluated.

data.description: When you roll damage for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are holding with two hands, you can reroll any 1 or 2 on a damage die and must use the new roll. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property.
data.note: When you roll damage with a melee weapon wielded with two hands (including Versatile used two-handed), reroll any 1 or 2 once. Modeled as damage.die.min UPGRADE 3 (minimum 3 per die). Engine cannot enforce two-handed hold requirement.

data.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.
data.note: +2 bonus to attack rolls with ranged weapon attacks. Fixed: was a stat-modifier (attack.bonus.ranged) that was never evaluated.

data.description: When you make the extra attack of the Light weapon property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack.
data.note: Add your ability modifier to the damage of your off-hand (bonus-action) attack. v0 evaluator doesn't model the off-hand split; surfaces as a trait flag.

data.description: Reaction: when a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you and you are wielding a shield, impose Disadvantage on the attack roll.
data.note: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you within 5 feet of you while you're wielding a shield, use your reaction to impose Disadvantage on the attack roll.

data.description: You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet. Within that range, you can effectively see anything that isn't behind Total Cover, even if you have the Blinded condition or are in Darkness.
data.note: You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet. Within that range, you can effectively see anything that isn't behind Total Cover, even if you're Blinded or in Darkness.

data.description: Reaction: when a creature you can see hits another target within 5 feet of you with an attack, reduce the damage dealt to that target by 1d10 + your Proficiency Bonus (minimum 0). You must be wielding a shield or a simple or martial weapon.
data.note: When a creature within 5 ft of you takes damage from an attack, use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + your proficiency bonus (min 0). Must be wielding a shield or a simple/martial weapon.

data.description: You can draw a weapon that has the Thrown property as part of the attack you make with it, and you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with such weapons.
data.note: +2 damage on any attack you make with a Thrown weapon (thrown attack).

data.description: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage. If you aren't wielding any weapons or a shield when you make the attack, that die becomes a 1d8. At the start of each of your turns, you can deal 1d4 bludgeoning damage to one creature you are grappling.
data.note: Unarmed strikes deal 1d6 + STR bludgeoning (1d8 with two free hands — engine cannot detect free-hand status; 1d6 applied unconditionally). Start of each turn: deal 1d4 to one Grappled creature (Out of Scope — no turn-start grapple-damage evaluator target).

data.description: Bonus Action: regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your Fighter level. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your uses per Short Rest (2 at level 1, increasing at higher levels).
data.note: Uses recharge on a Short or Long Rest. Heal 1d10 + Fighter level HP. Uses: L1=2, L4=3, L10=4.

activities.name: Second Wind
activities.note: Regain 1d10 + Fighter level HP. All uses recharge on a Short or Long Rest.

data.description: Choose 3 weapons you are proficient with. You gain access to the mastery property of each chosen weapon. You may swap one chosen weapon for another whenever you finish a Long Rest. The number of weapons you can master increases as you gain Fighter levels.
data.note: At L1 pick 3 weapons; gain access to their masteries. Mastery count scales: L1=3, L4=4, L10=5, L16=6. On a Long Rest you may swap one chosen weapon's mastery for another. v0 surfaces the initial choice flag and pick count; the per-level scaling of picks and the per-long-rest swap aren't enforced automatically. Weapon-mastery effects (Cleave, Push, Slow, Vex, etc.) aren't simulated.

data.description: On your turn, you can take one additional action. Once you use this feature, you must finish a Short or Long Rest before you can use it again (twice per rest at level 17).

activities.name: Action Surge
activities.note: On your turn, take one additional action. Once per turn.

data.description: When you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of your Second Wind to roll 1d10 and add it to the check, potentially turning a failure into a success. If the check still fails, you don't expend the use.

activities.name: Tactical Mind
activities.note: When you fail an ability check, expend one use to add 1d10 to the roll, potentially turning it into a success. If the roll still fails, the use is refunded.

data.description: At 3rd level, you choose a subclass that you specialize in. Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 10th, 15th, and 18th level.
data.note: Placeholder for subclass selection (Champion, Battle Master, Eldritch Knight, Psi Warrior in 2024). The chosen subclass slug lives on character.classes[].subclass.
